 ▶┌─ sort-by ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐e
  │                                                                                              │
  │ Sort by the given cell path or closure.                                                      │ ▶
  │                                                                                              │
  │ Docs: https://www.nushell.sh/commands/docs/sort-by.html                                      │
  │                                                                                              │
  │ Usage                                                                                        │
  │   sort-by {flags} <...comparator>                                                            │
  │                                                                                              │
  │ Flags                                                                                        │
  │   -r, --reverse      Sort in reverse order.                                                  │
  │   -i, --ignore-case  Sort string-based data case-insensitively.                              │
  │   -n, --natural      Sort alphanumeric string-based data naturally (1, 9, 10, 99, 100, ...). │ ▶
  │   -c, --custom       Use closures to specify a custom sort order, rather than to compute a   │
  │                      comparison key.                                                         │
  │                                                                                              │
  │ Parameters                                                                                   │
  │   ...comparator: oneof<cell-path, closure>  The cell path(s) or closure(s) to compare        │
  │                                             elements by.                                     │
